ABOUT.TITLE: About me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: Hi! I'm Sebastian. I'm a Junior Frontend Developer and an absolute CSS maniac. I love bringing designs to life and using my creative mindset and eye for detail to help create digital works of art.
ABOUT.LOCATION_TEXT: Based in Alzey, near Mainz. Generally open to remote positions.
ABOUT.TOOLS_TEXT: I love discovering new tools and expanding my skills with the ones I already know.
ABOUT.CREATIVITY_TEXT: My eye for the little things and my creative mind help me implement many complex designs. I enjoy brainstorming for the best solutions. Alone, but also gladly in a team.

SKILLS.SUBTITLE: Technologies
SKILLS.TITLE: Skill Set
SKILLS.DESCRIPTION: My skillset contains HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, TypeScript and Material Design. Furthermore, I am familiar with tools like Git, Firebase and RestAPI. Also techniques like Scrum and associated Kanbans like Trello are no strangers to me.

SEARCH.DESCRIPTION: Feel free to contact me. I look forward to expand my skills.

PROJECTS.TITLE: My Projects
PROJECTS.INFO_TEXT: Take a look at a selection of my works - interact with projects to see my skills in action.
PROJECTS.JOIN_DESC: A collaborative task management tool inspired by Trello – create and assign tasks, organize them by status via drag-and-drop, and manage a full contact list (create, edit, and delete).
PROJECTS.POLLO_DESC: A fun, fast-paced 2D platformer built with an object-oriented approach. Join Pepe in his epic battle against a chicken uprising – run, jump, and take down crazy hens by throwing Tabasco bottles.
